assertion10.statement: The actual cuspidal classical coordinate has Galois factor V_f and smooth adelic factor pi(V_f), including the p-factor defined from Fontaine WD.
assertion10.objects: Parabolic H1 of modular curves, cuspidal newform f, V_f, and Tate-normalized pi_p(V_f).
assertion10.hypotheses: Cuspidal f of integral weight k>=2 and finite conductor; finite coefficient extension contains its eigenvalues. Non-Eisenstein localization removes boundary cohomology.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every classical coordinate selected by the fixed-level lift; no exclusion of primes dividing Np.
assertion10.parameter_range: p=5 and k=v-u+1>=2; arbitrary finite conductor with prescribed tame compact invariants.
assertion10.uniformity: One global representation supplies both the away-from-Np Hecke eigenvalues and the local p-factor.
assertion10.constants: No analytic estimates or multiplicity-one constant is required.
assertion10.normalizations: Uniformizer maps to geometric Frobenius; final Eme Section2.1 uses Tate normalization and Section2.1.2 Fontaine WD^Fss at p.
assertion10.exceptional_cases: Weight1, Eisenstein and conjectural completed-cohomology identities are not used.
assertion10.limit_order: Pass to a classical coordinate before applying the exact published theorem; no inverse-limit base-change assertion.

assertion10.statement: The final HT inertia criterion plus two-dimensional linear algebra identifies every parameter containing the selected type with D tensor an unramified character.
assertion10.objects: Absolutely irreducible two-dimensional WD D, its finite inertia tau, K-type sigma(tau), and any smooth irreducible pi containing sigma.
assertion10.hypotheses: D is absolutely irreducible; coefficient field is enlarged finitely to split inertia and needed square roots; pi is infinite-dimensional, proved from sigma not being a character.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every such D and pi; no hypothesis on the residual reduction of the target representation.
assertion10.uniformity: Case split covers irreducible inertia and two distinct inertia characters exchanged by Frobenius.
assertion10.constants: In the two-character case c^2=a_prime*b_prime/(a*b) and d=a_prime/(c*a) give the explicit conjugacy diag(d,1)cFdiag(d,1)^-1=F_prime.
assertion10.normalizations: Both parameters use the same local Langlands and geometric Frobenius convention; only a single global unramified character is introduced.
assertion10.exceptional_cases: Scalar inertia/special series and ordinary target cases are excluded; no higher-rank type theorem is inferred.
assertion10.limit_order: No limit. Compare finite inertia, prove N=0, identify Frobenius, and only then conclude the unramified twist.

assertion10.statement: The lifted type selects a point x in the actual minimal global deformation problem with r_x potentially crystalline, weights u,v and WD(r_x)=WD(r) tensor nu.
assertion10.objects: The same auxiliary residual representation, actual conductor N, fixed-level completed cohomology, classical coordinate f, point x and local r_x.
assertion10.hypotheses: Reviewed all-weight fixed-level type lift and CEGGPS7.4 at no-vexing auxiliary representation; non-Eisenstein localization and residual absolute irreducibility of auxiliary object.
assertion10.quantifiers: Each target type and pair of distinct integral weights; the auxiliary object can depend on the type constituent.
assertion10.parameter_range: p=5; possible tame ramification2,193; no vexing primes; exact actual N is retained.
assertion10.uniformity: No residual irreducibility is transferred to the target r; it is used only for rho_x and the auxiliary fiber theorem.
assertion10.constants: k=v-u+1 and n=-u; epsilon(x)^n=|x|^n*x^n, so the smooth twist is |det|^n.
assertion10.normalizations: CEGGPS geometric Frobenius agrees with Eme inverse arithmetic Frobenius; WD(epsilon)=|.|; Sym dual contributes det^(-(k-2)).
assertion10.exceptional_cases: No nonminimal-level variant of7.4 is assumed; no independent proof of its full patching construction is claimed.
assertion10.limit_order: Type lift, finite Hecke eigencoordinate, Galois identification, common algebraic-factor removal, then type-parameter comparison.

assertion10.statement: The actual local Banach fiber at x has locally algebraic part pi_p(r_x) tensor W.
assertion10.objects: CEGGPS completed homology, its specialization at x, coefficient-field continuous dual, B_C(r_x), and the finite global Galois multiplicity factor.
assertion10.hypotheses: Exact7.4 and consolidated003 same-envelope identification; Colmez shape/nonvanishing; supercuspidal WD at x from the type argument.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every point x constructed in Section4; no statement for unrelated Banach representations with the same functor image.
assertion10.parameter_range: Finite coefficient field enlarged for x and factors; fixed tame level and algebraic weight.
assertion10.uniformity: Multiplicity of classical coordinates does not affect the conclusion; a nonzero coordinate on an irreducible lalg source suffices.
assertion10.constants: No tame multiplicity-one assumption; a finite sum of copies is enough.
assertion10.normalizations: Use homology quotient followed by continuous dual, giving cohomological annihilator of the maximal ideal.
assertion10.exceptional_cases: The special-series extension alternative is excluded by its constituents, not by ignoring Colmez exceptional case.
assertion10.limit_order: Specialize homology first, dualize, identify the annihilator, take lalg, and project to a classical coordinate.

assertion10.statement: The unramified parameter twist is unitary and the fixed-WD Colmez theorem transfers the actual lalg formula from r_x to the arbitrary target r.
assertion10.objects: Actual potentially crystalline r_x and r, common weights u,v, unramified parameter character nu and its Galois extension.
assertion10.hypotheses: Same inertia and WD up to nu; equal Hodge weights; admissibility of the filtered modules of actual representations; retained Colmez VI.6.42 and twist compatibility.
assertion10.quantifiers: All absolutely irreducible potentially semistable target r with absolutely irreducible WD and distinct weights.
assertion10.parameter_range: p=5; finite coefficient extension; integral u<v; common finite field of potential crystallinity.
assertion10.uniformity: No target residual condition enters; a common integral cyclotomic twist normalizes the weights for VI.6.9.
assertion10.constants: Total Newton difference is a nonzero fixed multiple of2*v_5(nu(Frob_geo)); equal Hodge totals force valuation zero.
assertion10.normalizations: Unitarity follows from filtered admissibility, not from the false rule that WD of every unitary Galois character is unitary.
assertion10.exceptional_cases: No use of modularity-dependent Colmez VI.6.51(ii), or assertion of the full BM/HT theorem.
assertion10.limit_order: Prove valuation zero before extending nu to G_Q5; remove nu, compare filtrations of exactly the same module, undo common and unramified twists.
